name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Grant Program currently sits in its own lifecycle.

name: totalBudget
label: Total Budget
description: The total amount set aside for this Grant Program, if the funder tracks one.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Funding Opportunity is still accepting applications.

name: applicationDeadline
label: Application Deadline
description: The date by which an Application must be submitted.

name: startDate
label: Start Date
description: When the Funding Cycle begins accepting applications.

name: endDate
label: End Date
description: When the Funding Cycle closes.

name: totalAmount
label: Total Amount
description: The sum of all budget categories in the proposed or funded Budget.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Letter of Inquiry resulted in an invitation to submit a full Application.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Application currently sits in the review process.

name: submittedDate
label: Submitted Date
description: When the Application was submitted, once it has been.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Review currently stands.

name: scheduledDate
label: Scheduled Date
description: When the Site Visit is scheduled to occur.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Site Visit has happened yet.

name: date
label: Decision Date
description: When the Decision was made.

name: outcome
label: Outcome
description: The result of the review process for the Application.

name: amount
label: Amount
description: The total amount committed under the Award.

name: currency
label: Currency
description: The currency the Award amount is denominated in, if not implied by context.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Award currently sits in the grant lifecycle.

name: date
label: Award Date
description: When the Award was made.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Grant Agreement stands in its own lifecycle.

name: effectiveDate
label: Effective Date
description: When the Grant Agreement's terms take effect.

name: restrictionType
label: Restriction Type
description: Whether the funding governed by these Terms and Conditions is Restricted or Unrestricted Funding. A coarse flag, superseded for new data by one or more structured Use Restriction Grant Terms (see grant-term), which can express what specifically the funding is restricted to or from -- retained here for backward compatibility.

name: requiredRatio
label: Required Ratio
description: The match ratio the Grantee must meet, e.g. "1:1".

name: matchType
label: Match Type
description: Whether the required match must be cash or may be in-kind.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Amendment stands in its approval process.

name: effectiveDate
label: Effective Date
description: When the Amendment's changes take effect.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether all Installments in the Payment Schedule have been disbursed.

name: amount
label: Amount
description: The amount scheduled for this Installment.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Installment has been disbursed, or is being held pending its Payment Condition.

name: amount
label: Amount
description: The actual amount transferred in this Payment.

name: currency
label: Currency
description: The currency the Payment was made in, if not implied by context.

name: date
label: Payment Date
description: When the Payment was sent or received.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Payment stands in transit.

name: conditionType
label: Condition Type
description: What kind of condition must be satisfied before the corresponding Payment is released.

name: amount
label: Amount
description: The amount being moved between budget categories.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the funder has approved the requested Budget Modification.

name: requirementType
label: Requirement Type
description: The kind of obligation the Compliance Requirement imposes.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Grantee has met the Compliance Requirement.

name: frequency
label: Frequency
description: How often Reports are due under this Reporting Schedule.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Report stands with the funder.

name: dueDate
label: Due Date
description: When the Report is due per the Reporting Schedule.

name: submittedDate
label: Submitted Date
description: When the Report was actually submitted, once it has been.

name: reportType
label: Report Type
description: Whether the Report covers narrative progress, financial use of funds, or both.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Audit stands.

name: scheduledDate
label: Scheduled Date
description: When the Audit is scheduled to occur.

name: rate
label: Rate
description: The indirect cost rate, expressed as a percentage of direct costs.

name: rateType
label: Rate Type
description: Whether the rate was individually negotiated or is the de minimis rate.

name: unit
label: Unit
description: The unit the Output is counted in, e.g. "workshops" or "people served".

name: status
label: Status
description: Where the Evaluation stands.

name: completedDate
label: Completed Date
description: When the Evaluation was completed, once it has been.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Award's Closeout has been completed.

name: date
label: Closeout Date
description: When Closeout was completed.

name: identifier
label: Identifier
description: A registration number or unique identifier for the organization (e.g., an EIN or DUNS number), if tracked.

name: taxIdentifier
label: Tax Identifier
description: The organization's tax identification number (e.g., an EIN), if applicable and disclosed.

name: jurisdiction
label: Jurisdiction
description: The legal jurisdiction (country or state) the organization is formed and regulated under.

name: taxStatus
label: Tax Status
description: The organization's tax-exemption status, independent of its legal form.

name: formationDate
label: Formation Date
description: When the organization was legally formed.

name: operatingStatus
label: Operating Status
description: Whether the organization is currently operating.

name: restrictionType
label: Restriction Type
description: The fund's accounting restriction status.

name: currency
label: Currency
description: The currency the fund's balance is denominated in.

name: openingDate
label: Opening Date
description: When the fund was established.

name: closingDate
label: Closing Date
description: When the fund was closed, if it has been.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the fund is currently active.

name: effectiveDate
label: Effective Date
description: When the arrangement took effect.

name: terminationDate
label: Termination Date
description: When the arrangement ended, if it has.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the arrangement is currently active.

name: governingDocument
label: Governing Document
description: The name or type of document that formally establishes the arrangement (e.g., a fiscal sponsorship agreement).

name: feePercentage
label: Fee Percentage
description: The fiscal sponsor's administrative fee, charged as a percentage of funds processed.

name: startDate
label: Start Date
description: When the Sponsored Project began operating under its Fiscal Sponsor.

name: endDate
label: End Date
description: When the Sponsored Project ended, if it has.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the Sponsored Project is still operating under its Fiscal Sponsor.

name: date
label: Recommendation Date
description: When the Donor Advisor made the recommendation.

name: status
label: Status
description: Whether the sponsoring organization has acted on the Grant Recommendation.

name: amount
label: Amount
description: The amount recommended, if the Donor Advisor specified one.

name: effectiveFrom
label: Effective From
description: When this role occupancy takes effect. Inherited by every Person Role and Organization Role subclass.

name: effectiveTo
label: Effective To
description: When this role occupancy ends, if it has a defined end. Must not precede Effective From.

name: status
label: Status
description: Where this role occupancy currently sits in its own lifecycle.

name: scope
label: Scope
description: How narrowly this role occupancy is scoped. A plain inline enum until Phase 3.7 Milestone 3's reference-data framework exists, at which point this becomes a governed vocabulary instead.

name: notes
label: Notes
description: Free-text context about this role occupancy not captured by its other properties.

name: issueArea
label: Issue Area
description: The primary social or environmental issue this Project addresses.

name: value
label: Value
description: The planned value for the indicator (e.g. "70%", "500 households"). A plain string so it can hold a numeric, percentage, or other planned value without a separate typed field per kind of indicator.

name: targetDate
label: Target Date
description: The date by which the target value is expected to be reached.

name: value
label: Value
description: The observed value for the indicator. A plain string so it can hold a numeric ("64%"), categorical ("improved"), ordinal ("high"), or textual observation without conflating these kinds of values into different fields.

name: observationDate
label: Observation Date
description: The date the value was observed.

name: claimType
label: Claim Type
description: Whether this claim asserts association, contribution, attribution, or causation.

name: evidenceStrength
label: Evidence Strength
description: How strong the supporting evidence is for this claim.

name: originalTermText
label: Original Term Text
description: The term's original source wording, preserved verbatim. Recommended for imported terms; the normalized classification is an interpretation of this text, not a replacement for it.

name: sourceSystem
label: Source System
description: The system this term was imported from (e.g. Tides), if any.

name: sourceRecordIdentifier
label: Source Record Identifier
description: The identifier of the source record this term was imported from, if any.

name: sourceField
label: Source Field
description: The source system's field this term was imported from, if any.

name: sourceClauseIdentifier
label: Source Clause Identifier
description: An identifier tying this term back to the specific source clause it was segmented from -- lets several Grant Terms normalized from one free-text field retain a shared linkage back to that field.

name: normalizationStatus
label: Normalization Status
description: Whether this term's normalization from source text is complete, partial, or still needs review. Preferred over forcing an uncertain clause into an incorrect category.

name: normalizationMethod
label: Normalization Method
description: How this term was normalized from its source. Machine-derived normalization is not treated as equivalent to source-provided structured data.

name: effectiveFrom
label: Effective From
description: When this specific term takes effect -- not assumed to equal the whole Grant Agreement's effective date.

name: effectiveUntil
label: Effective Until
description: When this specific term stops applying, if it has an end date.

name: restrictionType
label: Restriction Type
description: The nature of what this Use Restriction limits grant funds to or from.

name: restrictionMode
label: Restriction Mode
description: Whether this restriction requires a use, merely permits it, or prohibits it. An Award may carry more than one Use Restriction with different modes (e.g. a required-use restriction to a project, and a separate prohibited-use restriction on lobbying).

name: restrictedTo
label: Restricted To
description: Free-text naming what the funds are specifically restricted to (e.g. a project or program name), where applicable.

name: hasBarrier
label: Has Barrier
description: Whether this condition has a defined barrier that must be overcome. Captures the fact without the ontology itself concluding that the grant is legally or accountingly "conditional" -- that determination may require separate accounting or legal analysis.

name: conditionBarrierType
label: Condition Barrier Type
description: What kind of barrier this condition's entitlement, payment, continuation, release, or retention depends on.

name: thresholdValue
label: Threshold Value
description: The numeric threshold this condition's barrier is measured against (e.g. 250000, or 10 for a percentage), where applicable.

name: thresholdUnit
label: Threshold Unit
description: The unit the threshold value is expressed in (e.g. USD, percent, participants).

name: thresholdOperator
label: Threshold Operator
description: How the threshold value must be compared against to satisfy the condition.

name: dueDate
label: Due Date
description: The date by which this condition must be satisfied, where applicable.

name: conditionStatus
label: Condition Status
description: Whether this condition has been satisfied. Never inferred solely from dates.

name: failureConsequence
label: Failure Consequence
description: What happens if this condition is not met.

name: hasRightOfReturn
label: Has Right Of Return
description: Whether failing this condition creates a right for the funder to require return of funds already disbursed.

name: hasRightOfRelease
label: Has Right Of Release
description: Whether satisfying this condition releases funds that were otherwise being withheld.

name: approvalType
label: Approval Type
description: What kind of change, expenditure, action, or deviation this Approval Requirement governs.

name: approvalThreshold
label: Approval Threshold
description: The numeric threshold above which prior approval is required, where applicable (e.g. 10 for a 10% budget-reallocation threshold).

name: thresholdUnit
label: Threshold Unit
description: The unit the approval threshold is expressed in (e.g. percent, USD).

name: approvalStatus
label: Approval Status
description: Where a specific instance of this approval requirement stands.

name: approvalDate
label: Approval Date
description: When approval was granted, once it has been.

name: reportType
label: Report Type
description: What kind of report this requirement obligates.

name: frequency
label: Frequency
description: How often this report is due, reusing the same Frequency scheme Reporting Schedule already uses.

name: dueDate
label: Due Date
description: When a specific instance of this report is due.

name: reportingPeriodStart
label: Reporting Period Start
description: The start of the period this report covers.

name: reportingPeriodEnd
label: Reporting Period End
description: The end of the period this report covers.

name: requiredFormat
label: Required Format
description: The format the report must be submitted in, where the funder specifies one.
